name: ai-text-loading
title: AI Text Loading
description: A cycling status word whose letters blur in one by one while a soft brightness wave runs through them: the look of an AI that is working.
useWhen: A video needs a 'working on it' beat: an assistant thinking, a process running, a wait before a result.
A short list of status words should cycle with a calm, premium feel.
avoidWhen: The words must be read as a sentence: use per-word-crossfade.
A real progress bar or percentage is needed.
author: Kokonut UI

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Status words separated by |. Each one is shown in turn.

variables.label: Interval
variables.description: Seconds each word stays up. The block lasts 5 words at the default 1.5 s.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in pixels. Long words shrink to fit the frame.

variables.label: Show elapsed
variables.description: Show the seconds spent so far next to the word.
